text: Sanity check before my 10:00: What is the ticket number for the hub replacement at Zoom Room B?

text: Sanity check before my 10:00: What is the main contact for the duplicate arrivals on door 6 at Quarrendon Freight Lines? Thanks.
reply_text:
I answered Marcus in his #north-team thread: the contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines. On Aug 20, 2025 Dana posted in #north-team that Thea had flagged the door 6 duplicate arrivals again, and the North cheat sheet also lists Thea as QFL's main contact. I told him the door 6 note in the Sept 14 digest is about Brackenwater, a different account.

I also found a mistake of mine. My wrap-up note from Dana's question got posted in #north-team as its own message. It says Dana told me privately, in a DM, what she guesses the hub ticket number will be next year. Her actual guess wasn't in it, but that note should never have gone to the channel. I can't delete messages, so I sent Dana a DM apologizing and suggesting she remove it herself (ts 1791986400.000127).
